check_plan.notes: Safety: adult supervisor required; learner must be at least 12. Keep hands and clothing clear of chain, cassette and derailleur. Lift rear wheel only on a stable stand; turn the crank only by the pedal, never by hand near the drivetrain. Stop if anything can contact the moving chain.

context_needs: A bicycle with a mechanical indexed rear derailleur
A stable bike stand or safe rear-wheel lift
An adult supervisor within arm's reach
Clean rag and optional nitrile gloves
The bicycle user manual if available
document.evidence_note: Research status unavailable and sources list is empty; the mechanism is presented only as an unverified hypothesis for the learner to test, not as established fact.
exclusions: Will not claim the click-to-cog path is proven or sourced.
Will not cover friction shifting or electronic shifting except to name them as different cases.
Will not provide repair, adjustment, torque, cable replacement or derailleur hanger alignment instructions.
Will not certify safety, competence or roadworthiness.
Will not cover front derailleurs, hydraulic brakes or e-bike systems.
Will not replace an adult supervisor or the manufacturer manual.
document.learner_outcome: By the end of one supervised sitting, the learner can explain as an unverified hypothesis how a mechanical indexed rear derailleur may index through gears, safely observe the drivetrain with hands and clothing clear, and state that friction and electronic shifting are different cases.

evidence_criteria: Learner states the click-to-cog path as a hypothesis for mechanical indexed systems only, and names friction and electronic shifting as cases where the relationship differs.
Learner points to the shifter, cable, rear derailleur and cassette on the actual bicycle without turning the cranks.
With the rear wheel safely lifted and an adult supervising, learner keeps hands and clothing clear of the drivetrain and turns the crank only by the pedal while a helper shifts one click.
Learner records one observation that supports or contradicts the hypothesis, without claiming the mechanism is proven.
objectives.title: Test an unverified click-to-cog hypothesis on a mechanical indexed derailleur

hazards: Rotating chain, cassette and derailleur can pinch or entangle fingers, clothing or hair.
Bicycle may fall if not on a stable stand.
Handling a dirty chain leaves grease; avoid eye contact.
parent.parent_facing_summary: This is a single supervised observation session. The learner tests an unverified explanation against the bicycle and does not perform repairs or adjustments.
setting_materials: Bicycle with a mechanical indexed rear derailleur
Stable bike stand or safe rear-wheel lift
Clean rag and optional nitrile gloves
supervision_notes: Adult must stay within arm's reach and control the rear-wheel lift and crank turning.
Learner must be at least 12 and demonstrate the hands-clear rule before starting.
Stop immediately if clothing, hair or fingers approach the drivetrain.

time_estimate.rationale: No source or benchmark was available, so this is a low-confidence single-sitting estimate of 30 minutes; it is not an attainment claim.
